title: Man rescued by Coast Guard 78 Miles west Hudson, Fla.
description: A 25-year-old man is shown being medically evacuated by a Coast Guard aircrew aboard an MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter from Air Station Clearwater approximately 78 miles west of Hudson, Florida, Saturday, May 24, 2014. Watchstanders at Coast Guard Sector St. Petersburg command center received notification at 3 p.m. from a crewmember aboard a 55-foot fishing vessel reporting a crewmember was suffering from illness and in need of emergency medical assistance. U.S. Coast Guard video
